Container.Name: KoInsightBridge
Container.Overview: Bridge between KoInsight and BookLore. Every cycle it reads the page statistics KOReader uploaded to KoInsight, groups them into reading sessions (per device, split on pauses longer than GAP_MINUTES) and posts them to BookLore's /api/v1/reading-sessions, feeding its heatmap and timeline. Highlights and notes are converted from KOReader XPointers to EPUB CFIs and posted to /api/v1/annotations. Books are matched by KOReader's partial md5, the same value BookLore stores in book_file.current_hash; unmatched books are skipped.

Config.Name: state
Config.Description: Holds state.json, the watermark of what has already been imported

Config.Name: books
Config.Description: Read-only library, the same one BookLore indexes. Required for highlights: converting a KOReader XPointer into a CFI means opening the EPUB and counting the elements of the chapter

Config.Name: BOOKLORE_USER
Config.Description: BookLore account that owns the sessions

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: MariaDB host (read-only query mapping md5 to book_id)

Config.Name: DB_PASS
Config.Description: Password of the booklore user in MariaDB

Config.Name: GAP_MINUTES
Config.Description: A pause longer than this closes a reading session

Config.Name: MIN_SESSION_SECONDS
Config.Description: Drops sessions shorter than this (0 imports everything)

Config.Name: SYNC_ANNOTATIONS
Config.Description: 1 = import highlights and notes besides sessions

Config.Name: LIBRARY_ROOT
Config.Description: Where the library is mounted inside this container

Config.Name: DRY_RUN
Config.Description: 1 = only log what would be imported, without writing
